data.plainLyric:
We drank, and I convinced you that the wildfire smog was the Northern Lights
Lately, I've been lookin' at you harder, just takin' you in
At the callous on your fingers from the handbrake grips on your junkyard bike
And your boots so filled with water, I mean, soaking wet

But you could punch me in the gut
And it wouldn't hurt like watching you grow smaller on the backroad
And I never ask for much
But I hope that Logan crumbles and gets hit by a tornado

Oh, I can't keep on starting over
Sleeping in a bed half empty, daydreamin'
All love, must leave, oh, but search for it I will
Honey, tell me, are you good at stayin' still?
Are you good at stayin' still?
Oh, well, will you up and leave
Or will you be there in the morning?

I always hated the sunlight at 3 p.m
Where it's too soon to quit thinking, too late to change anything
I'm racking my brain for the one line that would change your mind
I'm showing you plane crashes online, couldn't hurt to try

But the Charles meets the sun
And the Harvard track team runs
Past my truck, stuck on Storrow
And I never ask for much
But I hope that Logan crumbles and gets hit by a tornado

'Cause I can't keep on starting over
Sleeping in a bed half empty, daydreamin'
All love, must leave, oh, but search for it I will
Honey, tell me, are you good at stayin' still?
Honey, tell me, are you good at stayin' still?
Are you good at stayin' still?

Put in love, put in hours, put in ceremony
As I was, how you were, what was there before me
Never mind, never mind, oh, forget about it
I'll be good, I'll be fine, I can laugh about it

I try to keep on starting over
I'm sleepin' in a bed half empty, daydreamin'
All love, must leave, oh, but search for it I will
Honey, tell me, are you good at stayin' still?
Are you good at stayin' still?
Are you good at stayin' still?
Oh, well, will you up and leave
Or will you be there in the morning?
